# Benchmark summary (generated by bench/summarize.py)

Assumed price for $/Bop (USD per billion operations, 2 provisioned vCPUs): 0.05 USD per vCPU-hour. This is an illustrative parameter, not a quote; rerun with --vcpu-hour.

CPU-s/Mop is CPU seconds per million operations (equal to CPU µs per operation). In the user/kernel table, multi-process topologies show the per-process median.
